prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square food image for a premium restaurant-menu studio portfolio, 1024 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: A convincingly real professional food photograph of lemon and herb ribbon pasta, generous fresh tagliatelle folds glossed with a light lemon-butter sauce, finely grated parmesan, fresh parsley and basil, visible tiny lemon-zest curls.
Scene/backdrop: Rustic/Dark style. Dark charcoal handmade ceramic shallow plate on a weathered dark walnut table with a loosely folded dark linen napkin subtly visible in one corner, warm black-brown background.
Composition/framing: One complete dish, plate centered and fully inside the square with a little breathing room for flexible website crop, shot from a natural 45-degree dining angle, food is the clear focal point.

Constraints: Single photograph, not collage, no frame, no text, no logo, no watermark, no people or hands. Absolutely no vector, illustration, CGI, 3D render, graphic circles, plastic-looking food, or cartoon appearance.
